name: rm-refuses-with-force-escape
body:
`rm` must refuse (exit 1, naming the dependent entity and the `--force` escape) when the entity still has children/dependents:
- `plan` with any PlanPhase (or task/planned node),
- `phase` with any Task,
- `task` with `status: done` or ANY incident `Feedback` (stricter §4 scope — a removed task would otherwise strand its resolved Feedback mirror),
- `planned` node referenced by a `creates` task.
`--force` overrides the refusal and removes the entity AND its children (cascade). `rm plan --force` removes the whole plan. Acceptance: each refusal case exits non-zero and leaves the store unchanged; the same rm with `--force` succeeds and cascades.
